apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.6

Offline status now appears in the header as MES STORE - offline with a grayscale store icon. The normal label and icon return automatically when internet connectivity returns. Removed the saved-catalog banner.

Tutorial illustrations appear directly within article sections. Tap an illustration to open it full screen, pinch to zoom, drag to move, or tap to hide controls. The header shows estimated reading time remaining, and returning preserves your reading position.

Improved text contrast on blue and disabled buttons, and moved page slogans closer to their titles.

This release supersedes the unpublished 1.2.5 phone preview and retains Android-confirmed app installation.

apps.name: SignPad
apps.description: Sign bills of lading, scan shipments, and keep warehouse work moving.
apps.releaseNotes:
SignPad 1.6.1

Back from the driver step restores the shipper's handwriting for review or correction. Includes the inspection and loading workflow and signed BOL printing integration.

Install over the existing SignPad app to keep pairing and authorization. MES authorization is required to access company data.
